proves.claim: clause 1: the addItem descriptor minimumEngine returns at least NEEDS_ENGINE when args[0].needs is set and the same value as today when it is not.

moves.add-item.needs-floor.why: Older replicas must not flatten an item needs field, so a move that carries it floors at the needs engine.
